sun.security.x509

接口 CertAttrSet<T>

  • 所有已知实现类:
    AuthorityInfoAccessExtension, AuthorityKeyIdentifierExtension, BasicConstraintsExtension, CertificateAlgorithmId, CertificateExtensions, CertificateIssuerExtension, CertificateIssuerName, CertificatePoliciesExtension, CertificateSerialNumber, CertificateSubjectName, CertificateValidity, CertificateVersion, CertificateX509Key, CRLDistributionPointsExtension, CRLNumberExtension, CRLReasonCodeExtension, DeltaCRLIndicatorExtension, ExtendedKeyUsageExtension, FreshestCRLExtension, InhibitAnyPolicyExtension, InvalidityDateExtension, IssuerAlternativeNameExtension, IssuingDistributionPointExtension, KeyUsageExtension, NameConstraintsExtension, NetscapeCertTypeExtension, OCSPNoCheckExtension, PolicyConstraintsExtension, PolicyMappingsExtension, PrivateKeyUsageExtension, SubjectAlternativeNameExtension, SubjectInfoAccessExtension, SubjectKeyIdentifierExtension, X509CertInfo

    public interface CertAttrSet<T>
    This interface defines the methods required of a certificate attribute. Examples of X.509 certificate attributes are Validity, Issuer_Name, and Subject Name. A CertAttrSet may comprise one attribute or many attributes.

    A CertAttrSet itself can also be comprised of other sub-sets. In the case of X.509 V3 certificates, for example, the "extensions" attribute has subattributes, such as those for KeyUsage and AuthorityKeyIdentifier.

    作者:
    Amit Kapoor, Hemma Prafullchandra
    另请参阅:
